playstyle: Lady Harrow's Mournflight fields four swift gheists — all Move 4, two with Fly — that depend on dodge saves for survivability. Playing under a generic Death warscroll, they either spend an action each round rolling for a persistent Locus of Shyish — granting allies Critical Grievous or stripping Move and Attack dice from foes — or raise slain fighters back to starting hexes and sacrifice small bodies to Stagger adjacent enemies. The warband wins by using its mobility to seize objectives early while debuffs and attrition grind opponents down.
